# Remove-ZbxReport

## SYNOPSIS

Removes scheduled reports.

## SYNTAX

```
Remove-ZbxReport [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixReport>[]> [-Force] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A scheduled report sends a PDF of a dashboard by email to users and user groups, daily, weekly, monthly or yearly. The Remove-ZbxReport cmdlet deletes the scheduled reports given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with report.delete, all in one call when the pipeline ends. It asks for confirmation first unless -Confirm:$false or -Force is given, and -WhatIf lists what would be deleted. It writes nothing, and needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Delete a scheduled report

```powershell
Remove-ZbxReport -InputObject 'Weekly ops summary' -Confirm:$false
```

Deletes the scheduled report Weekly ops summary. -Confirm:$false skips the prompt the command shows by default.

### Example 2: Preview deleting the scheduled reports a search finds

```powershell
Get-ZbxReport -Name 'Weekly*' | Remove-ZbxReport -WhatIf
```

Lists the scheduled reports whose names start with Weekly that the command would delete, and deletes nothing.
